title: Is GraphRAG Needed? From Basic RAG to Graph-/Agentic Solutions with Context Optimization
title_zh: Is GraphRAG Needed? 从基础 RAG 到 Graph-/Agentic 方案与上下文优化
abstract_en: As advanced RAG variants like GraphRAG and Agentic RAG emerge, one leading question is when and how to use them. Here, we introduce a framework for different RAG scenarios evaluation and comparison on semi-structured knowledge bases, including regular RAG, GraphRAG, Modular RAG and Agentic RAG. We provide implementation for 9 standardized RAG scenarios, and conduct experiments for a comprehensive comparison. These scenarios are designed for real use cases regarding data and domain restrictions, spanning from simple document-based retrieval to advanced features such as hybrid text-graph retrieval, integration with computed or pre-defined domain knowledge graphs, agentic multi-step planning, and agent-graph integration. Besides, we present a novel context engineering method for GraphRAG and Agentic RAG, addressing the context/memory overflow issues, efficiently managing text and graph retrievals with new representations and agentic loop design, leading to 19%-53% reduction on token usage. Moreover, further analysis identifies a retrieval-generation gap where expanded retrieval does not proportionally improve generation quality, suggesting retrieval-oriented metrics overstate advanced retrieval benefits. This work provides data-driven insights on when and how to use them for building production-ready intelligent RAG systems.
abstract_zh: 本文围绕“何时以及如何使用 GraphRAG 和 Agentic RAG”这一问题，提出了一个用于半结构化知识库场景下的 RAG 评估与比较框架，覆盖 regular RAG、GraphRAG、Modular RAG 和 Agentic RAG 等方案。作者实现了 9 个标准化 RAG 场景，并通过实验对这些方法进行了系统比较，场景设计面向真实应用需求，从简单的文档检索扩展到混合 text-graph 检索、结合计算得到或预定义的领域知识图谱、agentic 多步规划以及 agent-graph 集成等复杂能力。除此之外，论文提出一种面向 GraphRAG 和 Agentic RAG 的新型 context engineering 方法，用于缓解上下文/记忆溢出问题，通过新的表示方式与 agentic loop 设计，更高效地管理文本与图检索，token 使用量降低 19%–53%。进一步分析还发现，retrieval 与 generation 之间存在明显 gap：检索结果扩展并不一定能同比提升生成质量，这表明仅依赖 retrieval-oriented 指标会高估高级检索方法的实际收益。该工作为构建 production-ready 的智能 RAG 系统提供了数据驱动的选型与设计依据。
key_points_zh: 提出面向半结构化知识库的 RAG 评估框架，统一比较 regular RAG、GraphRAG、Modular RAG 和 Agentic RAG。
实现 9 个标准化 RAG 场景，覆盖从文档检索到 hybrid text-graph、知识图谱融合、agentic 多步规划等真实需求。
提出新的 context engineering 方法，缓解上下文和记忆溢出，token 使用量降低 19%–53%。
发现 retrieval-generation gap：更强的检索扩展不一定带来更好的生成质量。
指出仅看 retrieval-oriented 指标会高估高级 RAG 方案收益，需结合生成效果进行评估。

llm_assessment.comment: This is a useful RAG comparison study, but it is still mostly a retrieval-centric paper with limited agent-harness value.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇有用的 RAG 对比研究，但整体仍偏检索导向，代理基础设施价值有限。
